synchronization.title: Synchronization
synchronization.description: The status of syncing this office's data with the central system.
synchronization.apiUnavailableDescription: The backend does not currently provide synchronization status endpoints. No sample queue is shown.
synchronization.emptyDescription: Every change made in the office has reached the central system.
synchronization.explainer: Nothing is ever lost if the internet goes down here. Everything you record is saved on the office computer right away, and sent to the central system as soon as the connection is back.
